name: Equality Health Werribee
title: GP clinic
description: Equality Health Werribee, part of the Werribee Medical & Dental Centre, offers LGBTIQA+ health services including PrEP, sexual health consultations and Gender Affirming Therapy; Equality Health provides adult gender-affirming hormone therapy consultations using an informed-consent approach (18+). Since December 2024 the centre has partnered with the Victorian Sexual Health Network to provide sexual health and transgender health care services. Bulk billing available for eligible patients.
specialties: gender affirming hormone therapy, transgender health, LGBTIQA+ health, PrEP, sexual health
